summary: 20-point upgrade round tested (backend pytest 36 cases + 7 Playwright UI runs at 390x844). Backend 31/36 pass. WORKING: BUG1 admin delete (200 in 0.15s, scoped archive in deleted_user_archives, cascade counts, only that user's tickets+messages removed, unrelated ticket untouched); BUG2 register (+91 normalised, dup phone 400 readable, '12345' 400, clean reg 200 token + approved); BUG4 admin phone edit (normalised, phone_verified reset, dup 400, invalid 400); REQ8 mobile change (invalid 400, own number 400, other account's 409, OTP verify via otp_codes doc changes phone, id/wallet/orders unchanged; wrong OTP 400); REQ20 chat (403 with no shared order, 200 with shared order / approved provider, is_delivery_partner flags, newest-first sort; UI Delivery tab, no Downline); REQ16 all 10 banner artworks return images; REQ17 banner text PUT/GET, bad align/colour 400, apply returns festival.banner_text (branding doc restored afterwards); purge-old rejects non super admin. FAILING: REQ7 – all three role applications still 403 'Only members ... activate your membership first' for a new free account; REQ11/13 – account lock does not revoke existing sessions (GET /auth/me, /cart still 200 with old token after request; login is correctly blocked 403); an account_deletion ticket created via POST /tickets makes POST /me/account-deletion return already_requested without locking. Frontend: login three options/email form/eye toggle/back link/OTP card OK; profile rows + links OK, no WhatsApp/membership/Downline; change-mobile & account-deletion validation OK; category picker search OK (product editor + shop-layout block-cat-picker); icon search cctv/plumber OK; System Wallet collapsibles OK, no NaN. Financial invariant held: transactions 2827->2827, sum(wallet_balance) 287525.91->287525.91. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

critical.issue: REQ7 NOT DONE: still gated by `if not user.get('registration_paid')` -> 403 'Only members can ... activate your membership first'. New accounts are created with registration_paid=False (server.py register, otp_auth.py:161) so NO new user can apply. Refs: server.py ~9186, ~10200, routes/delivery_partner.py ~99

Account is not locked for already-issued tokens: it sets active_session_ids=[] but leaves legacy `active_session_id`; get_current_user (core/security.py ~311) then accepts the token because legacy_sid == token sid, and get_current_user never checks is_blocked. Verified: after the request GET /api/auth/me and /api/cart still return 200. Login is correctly 403.

minor.issue: If the user already has an open ticket with category 'account_deletion' (allowed via POST /api/tickets), endpoint returns {already_requested:true} and NEVER locks the account. Should still lock (or /tickets should reject that category / route to the deletion flow).

Unconditionally sets is_blocked=False/block_reason=None – would also lift an unrelated admin block (e.g. fraud). Does not clear deletion_ticket_id. Should only unlock if block_reason is the deletion one.

Archive uses to_list(2000) per collection (silently truncates heavy users) and stores everything in ONE document – a large account could exceed the 16MB BSON limit and 500 before deletion. Consider per-collection archive docs.
NOT executed (bulk destructive; preview has 193 snapshots / 10163 chunks so keep=10 would delete 183). Only auth gate tested (403 for normal user). Code review OK. Needs manual check.
